pages.text: A few small mods make growing food easier. $(thing)Berry Good$() improves berries. $(thing)Better Farming Right Click$() saves you replanting time. Seasons decide when crops grow.$(br2)Fruit trees, jams and pies come from the $(l:food/farmers_delight_addons)Delight add-ons$(/l).

pages.title: Berry Good
pages.text: Makes sweet berries less annoying to eat and adds berry foods: baskets, pips, meatballs, glowgurt and more. Glow berries get the same treatment.

$(bold)Better Farming Right Click$() lets you right-click a mature crop to harvest and replant it in one go. Toggle it from its in-game options; there is also a no-cooldown setting for tools and seeds.$(br2)Rice, tomatoes and onions come from $(l:food/farmers_delight)Farmer's Delight$(/l).

Seasons matter for crops. Serene Seasons ties growth to the calendar, so many crops struggle out of season; plan farms around it. Seasonal Integration extends this to other mods.$(br2)See $(l:survival/seasons)Seasons$(/l). Create farms: $(l:food/integrated_farming)Integrated Farming$(/l).
